items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Topo Gigio? [INTERVIEWEE] He had the little Italian mouse, you see how? Yeah, who could forget this.

ctx.x: Okay. Well my parents were, you know my father a lawyer in this town of Thunder Bay doing all kinds of law, a specialist in civil litigation but he would do a will or an accident case you know, or even a criminal, whatever was going on. My mother a lovely housewife. Both of them very musical and totally interested in show business. And to talk about that “Ed Sullivan Show” it was a lifeline because besides the teenage acts that he presented, Ed had everybody that was anybody in show business and he made stars at…

He had the little Italian mouse, you see how? Yeah, who could forget this. Senor Wences — a different guy, but he had yeah this thing. Boy that left an impact. And my parents took — they were very interested in Las Vegas, hearing about it, all, so many of these performers on television and on the talk shows Johnny Carson was our only talk show host at that time. We finally got cable TV from Duluth, Minnesota and were able to see Johnny Carson. And then, you know, Las Vegas, everybody seemed to be talking about it…
